submission.bindingBasis: The planning-time digest (sha256:e5d8...62ce64) no longer matches the current source state digest (sha256:79bc...b135127) due to an empty Git commit. The owner contract allows a caller to "after re-observation a caller may close against the new exact current digest." The tree bytes are identical, but the digest differs, so the planning binding failed with REVISION_MISMATCH/not_committed. The current binding attempt is "removed" — meaning no binding is in place. I must re-observe the workspace to obtain the new exact current digest before I can close against it.
submission.rationale: The intended consequence is to close the workspace against one exact expectedSourceStateDigest. The planning digest (e5d8...) does not equal the current digest (79bc...), even though the tree bytes are identical (only an empty commit changed the head revision and digest). The planning binding attempt already failed with REVISION_MISMATCH/not_committed, and the current binding attempt is removed, so there is no valid binding to act upon. The contract explicitly permits closing after re-observation against the new exact current digest. There is no new consequence created by re-observing; this is the necessary interim step before acting. I should not HOLD (progress can be made) and should not use the stale planning digest (would fail not_committed). Re-observation is required to obtain the current exact digest.
